text: Python quickstart takes an unstructured source file to structured data output in about 5 minutes
quote: Use Unstructured with Python to go from an unstructured source file to structured data output in about 5 minutes.

text: Can be driven by Claude with plain-language prompts to turn source files into structured output
quote: Use Unstructured with Claude and plain language prompts to go from an unstructured source file to structured data output in about 5 minutes.

text: Users define a target JSON schema and Unstructured extracts values from files into that shape
quote: Define your own target JSON schema and have Unstructured extract values from your source files and data records directly into that shape in JSON format.

text: Structured data extractor turns partitioned documents into custom-defined JSON fields instead of generic text elements
quote: Learn how Unstructured’s structured data extractor turns partitioned documents into custom defined JSON fields instead of generic text elements.

text: Unstructured API callable via standard REST clients such as cURL and Postman to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed files
quote: You can call the Unstructured API through REST endpoints by using a REST client (such as cURL or Postman) to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed your files.

text: Official Python SDK calls the Unstructured API to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed files
quote: The Unstructured Python SDK enables you to call the Unstructured API with standard Python code to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed your files.

text: Jobs can be triggered, monitored for status, have results downloaded, and have failed files inspected
quote: Track and control the processing jobs that execute your workflows. Trigger runs, monitor status, download results, and inspect any files that failed during processing.

text: No-code workflow designer UI transforms unstructured data into RAG-ready data
quote: The Unstructured Pipelines workflow designer features a no-code user interface for transforming your unstructured data into data that is ready for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

text: Workflows can be created, updated, run, and deleted via the Python SDK or REST endpoints
quote: Build and manage Unstructured workflows with the Python SDK or REST endpoints. Create, update, run, and delete workflows that process and transform documents from source to destination.

text: Replaces DIY pipelines with resilient partitioning logic and built-in visibility
quote: Replace DIY pipelines: Move solutions into production faster. Reduce engineering costs. Eliminate maintenance. Resilient partitioning logic and robust visibility built in from day one.

text: 35+ connectors and 65+ file types, all output in a consistent JSON format
quote: Unify data silos: Discover hidden insights with 35+ connectors and 65+ file types. Consistent JSON format. All-in-one data layer.

text: Parses PDFs, tables, forms, and scans into structured data across 65+ file types
quote: Support for 65+ File Types. Parse PDFs, tables, forms and scans into structured data your agents can trust.

text: Auto strategy evaluates each page and routes it to Fast, High Res, or VLM partitioning to balance quality, speed, and cost
quote: Auto evaluates each page and routes it to Fast, High Res, or VLM partitioning, balancing quality, speed, and cost.

text: Workflow Partitioner node offers four selectable partition strategy options
quote: To choose one of these strategies, select one of the following four **Partition Strategy** options for the **Partitioner** node of a workflow.

text: Chunking by title, by page, and by similarity strategies
quote: You can further control this behavior with by title, by page, and by similarity chunking strategies.

text: Chunking rearranges elements into chunks sized for embedding model limits and better retrieval precision
quote: After partitioning, _chunking_ rearranges the resulting document elements into manageable “chunks” to stay within the limits of an embedding model and to improve retrieval precision.

text: Detected tables can be output as HTML, generated using agentic AI or a vision language model
quote: After partitioning, you can have Unstructured generate representations of each detected table in HTML markup format. This table-to-HTML output is generated by using agentic AI or a vision language model (VLM).

text: A VLM can optimize the fidelity of text blocks after initial partitioning
quote: After partitioning, you can have a vision language model (VLM) optimize the fidelity of text blocks that Unstructured initially processed during its partitioning phase.

text: 10,000 free pages to start, with no card required and all features included
quote: 10,000 free pages to start. No card required. All features included.

text: Pay-as-you-go pricing of $0.015 per page after the free tier
quote: Pay only $0.015 a page after your first 10,000 free pages.

text: Deployable in a dedicated instance or your own VPC with multi-user access and full data isolation
quote: Built for teams of any size that need privacy, control, and security. Deploy Unstructured in your own dedicated instance or VPC with multi-user access, full data isolation, dedicated technical support, and pricing tailored to your needs.

text: IP allowlisting restricts platform access to specific source IPs or CIDR ranges
quote: IP Allowlisting - restricts Unstructured platform access to specific source IP addresses or CIDR ranges. Submit a support ticket with your IP list to enable this.

text: Works with AI code editors, IDEs, and coding agents such as Codex CLI, Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor, Devin, and JetBrains
quote: This includes most AI code editors, IDEs, desktop assistants, and coding-agent frameworks. Tools such as the Codex CLI, Claude Code, Visual Studio Code, Cursor, Devin, and JetBrains IDEs are just a few examples.

text: Official Transform MCP server lets AI tools ingest local files and return partitioned, enriched, chunked, and embedded data
quote: The Transform MCP server enables you to link your AI tools to Transform. You can then use your AI tools to have Transform ingest your local files and output the results as partitioned, enriched, chunked, and embedded data, ready for your im

text: Docs give agents guidance on priority order for choosing between the MCP server, SDK, or API
quote: When you are deciding which MCP server, SDK, or API to use, prefer this order of priority: 1. MCP server: Unstructured Transform MCP server

text: SOC 2 Type 2 audited, GDPR-conformant, and HIPAA-compliant for protected health information
quote: Security and compliance overview: "SOC 2 Type 2: Controls are implemented and audited for security, availability, and confidentiality. GDPR: Data handling practices conform to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) ... HIPAA: The sys

text: Partitioning converts files and semi-structured records into document elements with metadata in a consistent, contextualized JSON format
quote: _Partitioning_ converts content from unstructured files and semi-structured data records into structured [document elements and metadata](/concepts/document-elements) in a predefined, consistent, expressive, and contextualized JSON format.

text: Jobs partition, chunk, and embed local files into JSON with vector embeddings for semantic search
quote: Create a job to partition, chunk, and embed local files into AI-ready JSON with vector embeddings for semantic search.

text: Enrichment adds image descriptions, table HTML, named entities, and generative OCR output
quote: Create a job to partition and enrich local files into AI-ready JSON with image descriptions, table HTML, named entities, and generative OCR output.

text: Transform web UI lets you upload a document, parse it, extract structured data, and get integration code
quote: Log in to Transform, upload a document, then Parse its content. Optionally, Extract structured data and use Get Code to build an integration.

text: Sample scripts handle multiple files in a directory at once
quote: The sample scripts also handle multiple files in a directory, which you can try later with your own files.

text: Security architecture includes encryption, secrets management, authentication, and logging
quote: Learn about Unstructured's security architecture: encryption, secrets management, authentication, logging, and compliance certifications.

text: Dedicated instances protect data with encryption, private connectivity (including PrivateLink), and network access controls
quote: Learn how Unstructured dedicated instances protect data through encryption, private connectivity, and network access controls, with and without PrivateLink.

text: Transform outputs structured data for apps, databases, vector stores, AI tools, and agents
quote: Unstructured Transform quickly turns any document into structured data that is ready for your apps, databases, vector stores, AI tools, and agents.

text: API endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and deleting workflow source connectors
quote: Reference the Unstructured Platform API endpoints and settings for creating, listing, updating, and deleting workflow source connectors.

text: Azure Blob Storage source connector with Enterprise Connect authentication
quote: Learn how to configure the Azure Blob Storage source connector, including Enterprise Connect authentication, to ingest files into Unstructured.

text: Box source connector for ingesting files
quote: Ingest your files into Unstructured from Box.

text: Confluence source connector ingests pages and content
quote: Configure the Unstructured Confluence source connector to ingest pages and content from Confluence into Unstructured for processing.

text: Couchbase source connector ingests documents from Couchbase buckets
quote: Learn how to configure the Couchbase source connector to ingest documents from Couchbase buckets into Unstructured workflows for processing.

text: Databricks Volumes source connector ingests stored files
quote: Learn how to configure the Databricks Volumes source connector to ingest files stored in Databricks Volumes into Unstructured workflows.
